definitions.explanation: tending to obey or yield to others without resistance, often implying excessive passivity

examples.japanese: {服従的|ふくじゅうてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とった。
あまり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{服従的|ふくじゅうてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧だ。
examples.english: Being too compliant is a problem.

examples.japanese: ⟦{権力|けんりょく}→権力：10020_kenryoku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧{服従的|ふくじゅうてき}⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{美徳|びとく}→美徳：13899_bitoku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時代|じだい}→時代：01424_jidai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a time when being submissive to authority was considered a virtue.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{服従|ふくじゅう}→服従：15351_fukujuu⟧ (obedience/submission) and ⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧ (adjectival suffix). Describes someone who follows orders or yields to authority without resistance. Can be used neutrally (describing obedient behavior) or negatively (criticizing excessive passivity). The base noun ⟦{服従|ふくじゅう}→服従：15351_fukujuu⟧ carries a stronger connotation of subordination.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {服従的|ふくじゅうてき}な⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧: submissive attitude
- {服従的|ふくじゅうてき}な⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: compliant posture/stance
- {服従的|ふくじゅうてき}な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧: submissive personality
- {服従的|ふくじゅうてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become submissive

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{従順|じゅうじゅん}→従順：15864_juujun⟧: obedient, docile — emphasizes willingness to follow, often positive
- ⟦{消極的|しょうきょくてき}→消極的：04779_shoukyokuteki⟧: passive — broader, meaning lacking initiative in general
- ⟦{卑屈|ひくつ}→卑屈：07636_hikutsu⟧: servile, self-deprecating — negative, implies groveling
